title: 第1章 坑杀秦卒
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

前206年，历史掀开了崭新的一页，大秦帝国已然覆亡，谁将成为新的天下之主？是先入关中的刘邦？还是所向披靡的项羽？

先提几个小问题：刘邦的手下曹无伤为什么要举报自己的领导？项羽的叔叔项伯为什么要向张良通风报信？项羽不杀刘邦真的是因为心慈手软吗？我们来看看灭秦之后这两人都在忙些什么。

随着秦朝的覆灭，关中地区的统治秩序也陷入混乱，秦朝的法律条例不仅严酷，而且条目繁多，百姓不堪其扰。萧何认为：“如今之计，必须立即废除秦朝的繁苛律令，颁布几条新的管理条例，稳定关中地区的民心，标准怎么简单怎么来。”

刚刚从秦王宫纸醉金迷中恢复理智的刘邦立即发出通知，召集关中父老和地方豪强开个会。在会上，刘邦说：“大伙被秦朝的严刑苛法坑惨了，我出发前，楚怀王跟大伙约定，谁先入关中，谁就是关中王。照这么看，我就是关中王了。为了稳定关中地区的统治秩序，下面我提三点要求。”

底下人赶紧掏出小本本做笔记，回去后深入学习领会。

刘邦说了三句话：“第一，杀人偿命；第二，伤人和偷盗者要治罪；第三，其他法律一律废除。”

没了？这也叫开会吗？会议圆满结束，这就是历史上著名的“约法三章”。

乍一看，这三条内容也太简单了，把一套复杂的法律简化成这三句话不乱套了吗？其实这三点正是刘邦深思熟虑的结果，当时秦朝刚刚灭亡，民心不稳，这三点通俗易懂又好记，百姓们好理解，官员们好执行，很快就在百姓中传播开来。

为了安抚民众，紧接着刘邦又说：“我之所以到这里来，是为你们解除压迫的，而不是来欺负你们的，你们不必害怕。为了不影响大家的日常生活，我准备将队伍拉回灞上，等各路诸侯到齐后，再召开专题会议，商讨后续问题。”为了将讲话精神传达到每一处，刘邦组织了一支宣传队，和秦朝的官吏一起走街串巷、张榜安民，向百姓摆事实、讲道理。

关中百姓一看，刘邦的队伍不偷不抢，仁义啊！争相拿着牛、羊、酒来慰问。刘邦又一本正经演起了戏：“乡亲们的心意我心领了，但礼物我不能收！还请大家都带回去吧，我不想让大伙儿破费。”

刘邦这招以退为进玩得不错，百姓们果然又被感动了，唯恐刘邦不在秦地称王。从这一刻开始，刘邦从一个占领者变成了解放者，他失去了秦王宫的香车美女，却得到了天下人心。

然而，与此同时，刘邦又干了一件糊涂事，他身上有一个优点，很清楚自己的短板，所以在做一些决策的时候，乐于听取别人的意见。但是身为老板，下属的意见必须斟酌采纳。

在撤回灞上之后，有个猪队友给刘邦出了个主意：“关中是块宝地，富甲天下，形势易守难攻。章邯投降项羽后，被项羽封为雍王。如若让他们入关，那么你就得挪窝了。依我之见，得赶紧派人守住函谷关，阻止诸侯联军进入，征调关中士卒来增强自己的实力，这样才能挡住诸侯联军西进的脚步。”

这个主意很狗血，也很愚蠢，但刘邦却听进去了。为什么刘邦会犯这种低级错误呢？很简单，因为误判形势，他以为凭借着民众对自己的信任就可以关起门来当个“关中王”，殊不知这样做反而会激怒项羽和诸侯联军，将自己置于危险的境地。

果不其然，就在刘邦忙着收揽民心之时，刚刚在巨鹿之战中大败秦军的项羽正马不停蹄地向咸阳赶来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In 206 BC, history opened a new page. The Qin Empire had fallen. Who would become the new master of the world?Was it Liu Bang who entered Guanzhong first?Or the invincible Xiang Yu?

Let me ask a few questions first: Why did Liu Bang’s subordinate Cao Wushang report on his leader?Why did Xiang Yu's uncle Xiang Bo inform Zhang Liang?Is Xiang Yu really not killing Liu Bang because he is soft-hearted?Let's take a look at what these two people were busy with after destroying Qin.

With the fall of the Qin Dynasty, the ruling order in the Guanzhong region also fell into chaos. The laws and regulations of the Qin Dynasty were not only harsh, but also had numerous provisions, which made the people unbearable.Xiao He believed: "The current plan is to immediately abolish the Qin Dynasty's complicated laws and regulations, promulgate several new management regulations, and stabilize the people's hearts in the Guanzhong area. The standards should be as simple as possible."

Liu Bang, who had just regained his sanity from the intoxication in the Palace of Qin, immediately issued a notice to summon the Guanzhong elders and local powerful men for a meeting.At the meeting, Liu Bang said: "Everyone has been tortured by the harsh punishments of the Qin Dynasty. Before I set off, King Chu Huai made an agreement with everyone that whoever enters Guanzhong first will be the king of Guanzhong. According to this, I will be the king of Guanzhong. In order to stabilize the ruling order in the Guanzhong area, I will make three requirements below."

The people below quickly took out a small notebook to take notes, and studied and understood it in depth after returning home.

Liu Bang said three sentences: "First, murder must be punished with life; second, those who hurt and steal must be punished; third, all other laws must be abolished."

Gone?Is this also called a meeting?The meeting ended successfully, which is the famous "Three Chapters of the Agreement" in history.

At first glance, these three articles are too simple. Wouldn’t it be confusing to simplify a complex set of laws into these three sentences?In fact, these three points were the result of Liu Bang's careful consideration. At that time, the Qin Dynasty had just fallen and the people's hearts were unstable. These three points were easy to understand and easy to remember. They were easy for the people to understand and easy for the officials to implement. They quickly spread among the people.

In order to appease the people, Liu Bang then said: "The reason why I am here is to relieve your oppression, not to bully you. You don't have to be afraid. In order not to affect everyone's daily life, I am going to pull the team back to Bashang and wait.After the princes from all walks of life have arrived, a special meeting will be held to discuss follow-up issues." In order to convey the spirit of his speech to every place, Liu Bang organized a propaganda team to go through the streets with the officials of the Qin Dynasty, put out announcements to appease the people, and present facts and reason to the people.

When the people in Guanzhong saw it, Liu Bang's team neither stole nor robbed, how benevolent and righteous!They rushed to bring cattle, sheep, and wine to express condolences.Liu Bang acted seriously again: "I appreciate the wishes of the folks, but I can't accept the gifts! Please take them all back. I don't want everyone to waste money."

Liu Bang's move of retreating in order to advance was a good one, and the people were indeed moved again, fearing that Liu Bang would not become king of Qin.From this moment on, Liu Bang changed from an occupier to a liberator. He lost the beautiful women in the palace of Qin, but gained the hearts of the world.

However, at the same time, Liu Bang did another stupid thing. He had an advantage. He was very aware of his own shortcomings, so he was willing to listen to other people's opinions when making some decisions.But as a boss, the opinions of your subordinates must be considered and adopted.

After retreating to Bashang, a pig teammate gave Liu Bang an idea: "Guanzhong is a treasure land, rich in the world, and the situation is easy to defend but difficult to attack. After Zhang Han surrendered to Xiang Yu, he was named King Yong by Xiang Yu. If they are allowed to enter the pass, then you have to move. In my opinion, you must quickly send people to guard Hangu Pass to prevent the coalition forces from entering, and recruit soldiers from Guanzhong to strengthen your own strength, so that you can stop the westward advance of the coalition forces."

This idea was bloody and stupid, but Liu Bang listened.Why did Liu Bang make such a stupid mistake?Quite simply, because he misjudged the situation, he thought that relying on the people's trust in him, he could close the door and become the "King of Guanzhong". Little did he know that doing so would anger Xiang Yu and the coalition of princes and put himself in a dangerous situation.

Sure enough, while Liu Bang was busy winning over the people, Xiang Yu, who had just defeated the Qin army in the Battle of Julu, was rushing towards Xianyang non-stop.
